en.headline: Customs log 627 Hotstone Yoga complaints worth about HK$7 million
en.dek: Reports of unused prepaid classes have risen from 381 cases and about HK$4.07 million recorded by Friday afternoon.
body: Customs had received 627 complaints about Hotstone Yoga by 6pm on Saturday, involving service contracts worth about HK$7 million, Sing Tao reported.

The centre, which offered hot-stone yoga, had announced it was closing all outlets. Customs said on Friday that, as of 5pm that day, it had logged about 381 reports involving about HK$4.07 million, after customers said prepaid classes could not be honoured once the business shut.

The department said it had arrested a 61-year-old male company director on Friday on suspicion of wrongly accepting payment under the Trade Descriptions Ordinance. He has not been charged. Customs said the investigation was continuing.
The figures are those given by the department and reported by Sing Tao. They may change as more customers come forward.

zh.headline: 海關接627宗岩盤瑜伽舉報 涉款約700萬元
zh.dek: 星島報道，截至周六下午6時，舉報由周五約381宗、約407萬元增至627宗，涉預繳課程未能兌現。
body: 星島報道，海關表示截至周六下午6時，共接獲627宗有關Hotstone Yoga的舉報，涉及約700萬元服務合約。
該中心提供岩盤瑜伽，日前宣布全線結業。海關周五表示，截至當日下午5時，接獲約381宗舉報，涉案金額約407萬元。市民投訴購買預繳式課程後，因商戶結業而未能使用。
海關周五採取特別執法行動，拘捕一名61歲公司男董事，涉嫌違反《商品說明條例》中「不當地接受付款」。他尚未被控。海關表示調查仍在進行。
上述數字為海關向傳媒提供、由星島報道的數字，若再有市民舉報，數字或會更新。
